findings.summary: RegExp origin analysis reuses wrapper traversal and rejects ineligible receivers before indexing program facts.
GPU sinks and optional calls reuse shared sink and optional-access lowering.
Shared record view matching indexes source fields once and reuses cycle-safe source traversal.
Promise completion fixtures share the async oracle harness.
Resource index snapshots reuse pinOperand and logical JSON guards reuse logicalAssignmentGuard.
Nullable collection construction allocates only the selected owner; receiver snapshots follow shared effect analysis.
Promise.any reserves error storage for sized inputs.
Synchronous and awaited completion metadata share one body proof.
Indexed and ordinary array iteration share the retained-owner loop emitter.
Bindings and resource stores share representedStorage for backing carrier selection.
Direct and optional resource identity reuse the runtime pair equality contract.
Default Map entry projectors use empty storage; custom projectors remain stateless.
Class owner-return lowering reuses final-return analysis and retains recursion guards.
